subject: english
stem:
The route looks short on the map. In fact, a steep hill makes it take nearly an hour.
What is the writer's main point?
options: All hills take exactly one hour
The route takes longer than its map length suggests

optionRationales.reason: The route looks short：只保留初步外觀。
All hills take exactly one hour：原文只談此 route 且 nearly。
The route has no hill：與 steep hill 相反。
The route takes longer than its map length suggests：In fact 修正從短距離形成的快速預期。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「轉折標記後的修正、限制或作者真正採納的立場」可推出 The route takes longer than its map length suggests；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The route takes longer than its map length suggests 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
